# Epitome

> Single-origin Ceylon specialty coffee from the central highlands of Sri Lanka. The essence of Ceylon coffee.

Epitome is a Sri Lankan luxury coffee brand reviving the island's pre-tea coffee heritage. One coffee: Epitome — a 500 g bag of whole-bean, medium-roast, single-origin Arabica grown at 1,200–1,800 m in shade-grown Kandyan gardens.

## Key facts
- Brand: Epitome
- Product: Epitome — 500 g, whole bean, medium roast, single-origin Ceylon Arabica
- Origin: Central Highlands, Sri Lanka (1,200–1,800 m)
- Tasting notes: dark chocolate, vanilla, stone fruit; moderate acidity, silky body
- Brew: pour-over (18 g / 93 °C / ~300 ml), espresso, French press, moka, cold brew
- Availability: reserve online; also in select Sri Lankan supermarkets
- Contact: support@epitomearabica.com
